EvaluationConfig.description_en: This configuration structure defines the JSON paths needed to extract specific values from trace data in JSON format. They are required for evaluation operations
EvaluationConfig.description_zh: 从json格式的链路数据里要一些提取特定路径上的值，作为评估操作的输入。在这个EvaluationConfig结构体里定义这些json路径

Answer.description_en: The answer to the user's question from the LLM application
Answer.description_zh: 基于大语言模型的应用针对用户问题的回答

JsonPathInSpan.description_en: The JSON path where the Answer is stored in the trace log

JsonPathInSpanValue.description_en: If the value retrieved at the JSON path is itself a JSON string, a further JSON path must be defined within this JSON to obtain the actual value
JsonPathInSpanValue.description_zh: 如果json path处取到的值本身仍然是json string，那么需要进一步定义这个json里的json path以获取实际的值

SpanName.description_en: The span name in the trace log

Context.description_en: The context node information referenced when the model answers a question
Context.description_zh: 大模型回答问题时参考的上下文节点信息

JsonPathInSpan.description_en: The JSON path where the Context is stored in the trace log

JsonPathInSpanValue.description_en: If the value retrieved at the JSON path is itself a JSON string, a further JSON path must be defined within this JSON to obtain the actual value
JsonPathInSpanValue.description_zh: 如果json path处取到的值本身仍然是json string，那么需要进一步定义这个json里的json path以获取实际的值

SpanName.description_en: The span name in the trace log

Query.description_en: The question from the user to the LLM application
Query.description_zh: 用户向基于大语言模型的应用提出的问题

JsonPathInSpan.description_en: The JSON path where the Query is stored in the trace log

JsonPathInSpanValue.description_en: If the value retrieved at the JSON path is itself a JSON string, a further JSON path must be defined within this JSON to obtain the actual value
JsonPathInSpanValue.description_zh: 如果json path处取到的值本身仍然是json string，那么需要进一步定义这个json里的json path以获取实际的值

SpanName.description_en: The span name in the trace log

ModelConfig.description_en: The access configuration structure of the model used in the evaluation
ModelConfig.description_zh: 评估任务内部使用的大模型的访问配置结构体

ApiKey.description_en: The authentication key required when the evaluation task calls a model which the user has permission to use, acting under the user's name
ApiKey.description_zh: 评估任务需要以用户名义调用用户有使用权的大模型时，需要填充的认证key

Endpoint.description_en: The model service endpoint required when the evaluation task calls the model
Endpoint.description_zh: 评估任务需要以用户名义调用用户有使用权的大模型时，需要填充的模型服务地址

IsSelfHost.description_en: Whether the model service is provided by the user (True), or by Alibaba Cloud PAI (False)
IsSelfHost.description_zh: 用户的大模型服务是自己提供的(True)、还是阿里云PAI提供的(False)

Temperature.description_en: Controls the randomness of the model output. Maximum value: 0.2
Temperature.description_zh: 控制大模型输出随机性的温度参数。最大可设置到0.2

TopP.description_en: Controls the randomness of the model output
TopP.description_zh: 控制大模型输出随机性的top p参数

UseFunctionCall.description_en: Whether the model is allowed to use external tools
UseFunctionCall.description_zh: 评估任务需要以用户名义调用用户有使用权的大模型时，是否允许大模型调用外部工具

description_en: Get the details of an online evaluation task
description_zh: 获取指定链路评估任务的详细信息，包括名称、评估模型配置，起止时间等信息
name: GetOnlineEvalTask

Code.description_en: Internal error code. Set only when the response is in error
Code.description_zh: 内部错误码。只在响应出错时被设置

Message.description_en: Response error message. Set only when the response is in error
Message.description_zh: 响应错误信息。只在响应出错时被设置

AliyunUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) of the task creator
AliyunUid.description_zh: 任务创建者的阿里云账号（主账号）

AppName.description_en: The name of the user application targeted by this task
AppName.description_zh: 该任务针对的用户应用的名称

EvalResults.description_zh: 从该任务所有的评估结果，通过聚合计算得到的聚合评估结果
EvalResults.example: [{"task_id": "11111", "result_type": "HasValidEvalResult", "record_count": 8, "faithfulness": 0.5, "correctness": 0.5, "ndcg": null, "mrr": null, "hit_rate": null, "precision": null}, {"task_id": "11111", "result_type": "FailedToExtractQCA", "record_count": 3, "faithfulness": 0.0, "correctness": 0.0, "ndcg": null, "mrr": null, "hit_rate": null, "precision": null}]

EvaluationConfig.description_en: Extract specific path values from JSON-formatted trace data as input for the evaluation operation. These JSON paths are defined within this EvaluationConfig structure
EvaluationConfig.description_zh: 从json格式的链路数据里要一些提取特定路径上的值，作为评估操作的输入。在这个EvaluationConfig结构体里定义这些json路径

Filters.description_en: The evaluation task needs to search for a certain amount of trace data generated by the user application as input data for the evaluation operation. This is a list that defines the search filter conditions
Filters.description_zh: 评估任务要搜索一定量的用户应用产生的链路数据，作为评估操作的输入数据。这是定义搜索筛选条件的列表

Key.example:
ServiceId
ServiceName
Input
Output
Status
TraceType
SpanType
TraceName
SpanName

GmtCreateTime.description_en: UTC creation time of the task

GmtEndTime.description_en: UTC end time of the trace data

GmtLastSamplingWindowEndTime.description_en: UTC upper bound of the last sampling window
GmtLastSamplingWindowEndTime.description_zh: 最后一次采样窗口的UTC结束时间

GmtLastSamplingWindowStartTime.description_en: UTC lower bound of the last sampling window
GmtLastSamplingWindowStartTime.description_zh: 最后一次采样窗口的UTC开始时间

GmtStartTime.description_en: UTC start time of the trace data

ModelConfig.description_en: Access configuration structure for the large model used internally by the evaluation task
ModelConfig.description_zh: 评估任务内部使用的大模型的访问配置结构体

SamplingFrequencyMinutes.description_en: The evaluation task needs to search for a certain amount of trace data generated by the user application as input data for the evaluation operation. This defines the width of the time window for each search of input data
SamplingFrequencyMinutes.description_zh: 评估任务要搜索一定量的用户应用产生的链路数据，作为评估操作的输入数据。这是定义任务每次搜索输入数据的时间窗口的宽度

SamplingRatio.description_en: The percentage of the data found within a time window that is actually used as input for the evaluation task. For example, 100 means all the found data is used as input, 20 means 20% of the found data is randomly selected as input
SamplingRatio.description_zh: 评估任务在一个时间窗口里搜索到的数据，真正作为评估输入数据的百分比。比如100表示搜索到的所有数据都作为评估输入。又比如20表示从搜索到的数据里随机取20%作为评估输入

UserId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud sub-account of the task creator
UserId.description_zh: 任务创建者的阿里云子账号
